records.Concise description: Major U.S.-founded custodial platform combining retail brokerage, advanced spot trading, custody and institutional execution for bitcoin and other assets.
records.Deeper researched summary: Coinbase launched in 2012 around a simpler way to buy and sell Bitcoin and grew into a multiasset custodial exchange. Coinbase.com hosted balances are custodial: Coinbase controls the private keys until users withdraw. Coinbase Advanced is a trading interface under the same canonical entity rather than a separate profile. Current Coinbase support also documents Bitcoin Lightning send/receive functionality, with jurisdictional exclusions including some markets.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2012. Coinbase evolved from a Bitcoin brokerage into a global multiasset exchange; GDAX became Coinbase Pro and later the Advanced trading experience.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Coinbase was one of the most important bridges from early Bitcoin brokerage to regulated U.S. retail/institutional crypto market infrastructure.
Important technical or cultural characte: Retail brokerage plus order-book spot trading
Coinbase Wallet is a separate self-custody product and not the same custody model
records.Verification basis: Current Coinbase user agreement and help material verify hosted custody, withdrawals and current Lightning support; historical/legal context is supported by primary U.S. regulatory material.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not conflate Coinbase.com hosted custody with Coinbase Wallet self-custody.
Lightning availability is jurisdiction-specific and should be rechecked before publication.
Registration/licensing must be stated by entity and jurisdiction, not summarized as 'globally regulated'.

records.Concise description: Long-running centralized exchange offering custodial bitcoin spot trading, fiat rails, withdrawals, APIs and institutional services across multiple legal entities.
records.Deeper researched summary: Kraken was founded in 2011 and began public trading in 2013. It remains a custodial exchange: customers fund platform-controlled accounts to trade and then withdraw to external Bitcoin addresses. Kraken supports Lightning deposits and withdrawals in current help material. Its services and regulatory registrations are split among jurisdiction-specific entities, so MSC should avoid a single blanket regulatory label.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2011 and launched trading in 2013. Kraken became one of the longest-running large centralized Bitcoin exchanges and expanded into institutional, derivatives and staking products.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Kraken is historically important as an early post-Mt.-Gox-era Bitcoin exchange that persisted into the institutional multi-market era while maintaining direct BTC withdrawal support.
Important technical or cultural characte: BTC spot markets and fiat rails
records.Verification basis: Current Kraken legal/support material verifies active operation, jurisdiction-specific legal entities and Lightning funding; historical launch details are well established in Kraken first-party materials.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not present a single Kraken license as covering every service or territory.
Derivatives availability is jurisdiction-specific and separate from spot-exchange availability.

records.Concise description: Large global custodial exchange launched in 2017 with deep BTC spot and derivatives markets, fiat/crypto rails and broad trading infrastructure.
records.Deeper researched summary: Binance grew rapidly after its July 2017 launch into a global multiasset exchange where users deposit assets into Binance-controlled custody for trading. Bitcoin remains foundational through spot, derivatives and withdrawal markets. Binance integrated Bitcoin Lightning deposits/withdrawals in 2023; current API documentation still exposes the LIGHTNING network, but feature availability should be treated as account/region dependent. U.S. criminal resolutions in 2023 concerned Binance Holdings' AML, money-transmission and sanctions violations; founder Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty separately and resigned. Those are dated legal facts, not a lifecycle classification.
records.Launch / history: Launched in July 2017. Binance grew into a major global exchange; in November 2023 Binance Holdings entered a U.S. guilty plea/resolution and CZ separately pleaded guilty and resigned as CEO.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Binance materially shaped global Bitcoin liquidity, derivatives, fee competition and exchange infrastructure, even though it is not Bitcoin-only.
Important technical or cultural characte: Global service availability varies substantially by legal entity and jurisdiction

Corroborating sources.label: U.S. DOJ — Binance and CEO guilty pleas / resolution

records.Verification basis: Current Binance product/API material verifies active Bitcoin markets and Lightning network support; the 2023 U.S. resolution is sourced to DOJ primary material.
Research notes / uncertainties: This profile covers Binance.com/global exchange lineage, not Binance.US as though it were the same legal entity.
Do not turn the 2023 U.S. resolution into a current blanket claim about legality in every jurisdiction.
Lightning availability should be reverified at publication time.

records.Concise description: Global centralized exchange offering custodial BTC spot/derivatives trading, withdrawals, APIs and institutional services.
records.Deeper researched summary: OKX is the current exchange brand descended from OKEx. Users deposit assets into platform custody for centralized trading and can withdraw bitcoin externally. Current OKX help documentation supports both Bitcoin Lightning deposits and withdrawals while warning that support can vary by customer and region. The OKX self-custody wallet is a separate product and should not be used to describe exchange custody.
Creators / founders: Star Xu — founder of OK Group / OKEx lineage
records.Launch / history: OKEx launched in 2017 and later rebranded to OKX as the company broadened its product suite.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: OKX is a durable global venue for BTC spot and derivatives liquidity and an important example of a centralized exchange that also operates a separate self-custody wallet ecosystem.
Important technical or cultural characte: Lightning deposits and withdrawals where supported
records.Verification basis: Current OKX exchange/help material verifies active BTC trading, withdrawals and Bitcoin Lightning funding with explicit availability caveats.
Research notes / uncertainties: Lightning support does not apply uniformly to every customer/region.
Do not conflate OKX exchange custody with OKX Wallet self-custody.
Regulatory permissions differ across OKX legal entities and countries.
